name: [🎖️] RUSH POINT
desc:
Rush Point is a high-stakes, team-based shooter where quick reflexes, sharp aim, and tactical coordination lead to victory. Engage in thrilling matches across diverse, competitive maps where every round is a fresh opportunity to dominate.

Secure eliminations, complete objectives, and earn currency each round to build your loadout. Choose from a growing arsenal of weapons, gadgets, and utility tailored to your playstyle.

With agent-based abilities, ranked ladders, player stats, unlockable cosmetics, and regular content drops, Rush Point offers a modern FPS experience optimized for Roblox.

🎯 Precision gunplay blended with strategic ability use
🧠 Smart economy system—buy the right tools at the right time
🛡️ Multiple playable agents, each with unique strengths
🎁 Crates, skins, and badges to collect and trade
🔥 Frequent updates and evolving competitive balance

Join the fight, master your agent, and rise through the ranks. Rush Point is just getting started.

🎮Inspired by Valorant
